theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : x + 1 / x ≥ 2 := by
  have h : x + 1 / x - 2 = (x - 1) * (x - 1) / x := by
    rw [sub_add, sub_eq_sub, add_sub, mul_sub, sub_self]
    ring
  have nonneg : (x - 1) * (x - 1) / x ≥ 0 :=
    le_div_of_nonneg_mul_pos (sq_nonneg (x - 1)) (mul_pos hx (inv_pos hx))
  exact le_trans nonneg (le_rfl (div_nonneg_of_nonneg_mul_pos (sq_nonneg (x - 1)) (mul_pos hx (inv_pos hx))))
